# Read in Data

```{r}
# Clearing environment so code runs fresh
  rm(list=ls())

# Read in composite survey data  
composite_scores <- read.csv(here("Subjective Data", "JW All Friempathy Survey Data.csv")) 

```


##Wrangle columns of interest and arrange

```{r}

#rename ID column
composite_scores <- composite_scores %>%
  rename(SID = ID)

#remove Qualtrics metadata from SID column
composite_scores <- composite_scores[-1, ]

#check whether any participants' partners not present in data by creating new variable to note this
composite_scores <- composite_scores %>% #everyone has a partner  
  group_by(DyadID) %>%
  mutate(has_partner = n() == 2) %>%
  ungroup()

#sample size before participant removal
print(length(unique(composite_scores$SID)))

#remove participants from data due to original research team decisions  
composite_scores <- composite_scores[-c(89, 197, 101, 102, 133, 134), ] #these are SIDs 2045a, 2099a, 2051a, 2051b, 2067a, 2067b

#make all SIDs only include lowercase values and ensure no white space
composite_scores <- composite_scores %>%
  mutate(SID = str_to_lower(SID),     
         SID = str_trim(SID))

#select variables of interest before merge
composite_scores <- composite_scores[ , -c(12:144, 176:207, 232:560, 625:689, 710:747, 768:823, 832:835, 838:855, 859:864, 867:881, 884:889)]

#convert those -999 values to NA
composite_scores[composite_scores == -999] <- NA

```


# Merge Subjective Data with Remaining Modalities: EEG, Behavioral, HRV 

``` {r}

#note that due to how r project file paths originally constructed and beginning workflow with subjective data, the subjective data folder will be the working data folder for all data types during wrangling/analysis; any edits made to excel files containing data for analysis needs to be saved as csv copy in subjective data folder

#read in EEG data
EEG_data <- read.csv(here("Subjective Data", "All_Conditions_Alpha_Results.csv"))

#read in behavioral data
Behav_data <- read.csv(here("Subjective Data", "Compiled Response Type Frequencies & Durations.csv"))

#remove unnecessary behavioral rows
Behav_data <- Behav_data[-c(202:998), ]

#read in HRV data  
HRV_data <- read.csv(here("Subjective Data", "Friempathy Cleaned RMSSD & HR Values.csv"))

#remove unnecessary HRV rows
HRV_data <- HRV_data[-c(96:199), ]

#exclude 2006a from HRV data due to being flagged for exclusion during preprocessing
HRV_data <- HRV_data[-8, ]

#rename ID variables  
EEG_data <- EEG_data %>%
  rename(SID = Subject)

Behav_data <- Behav_data %>%
  rename(SID = ID)

#merge subjective with remaining modalities 
All_data <- composite_scores %>%
  full_join(EEG_data, by = "SID")  #keep participants with missing EEG data 

All_data <- All_data %>%  
  full_join(Behav_data, by = "SID") #keep participants with missing behavioral data

All_data <- All_data %>%
  full_join(HRV_data, by = "SID") #keep participants with missing HRV data

#remove unnecessary All_data rows
All_data <- All_data[-c(364:467), ]

#ensure that participants excluded from study due to team decisions (as reflected in composite_scores above) holds for All_data
All_data <- All_data[-c(359:363), ]

#rename columns so easier to work with
All_data <- All_data %>%
  rename(CognitiveEmpathyDuration_sec = Cognitive.Empathy.Duration..seconds.,
         CognitiveEmpathyFrequency = Cognitive.Empathy.Frequency,
         AffectiveEmpathyDuration_sec = Affective.Empathy.Duration..seconds.,
         AffectiveEmpathyFrequency = Affective.Empathy.Frequency,
         NesfPersonalDistressDuration_sec = NESF.Personal.Distress.Duration..seconds.,
         NesfPersonalDistressFrequency = NESF.Personal.Distress.Frequency)

All_data <- All_data %>%
  rename(SegmentBeatsCorrected = Segment.Beats.Corrected,
         BeatCorrectionThreshold = Beat.Correction.Threshold,
         RMSSD_ms = Segment.Mean.RMSSD..ms.,
         HR = Segment.Mean.HR..bpm.,
         TotalRecordingBeatsCorrected = Total.Recording.Beats.Corrected,
         TotalRecordingBeatCorrectionRate = Total.Recording.Beat.Correction.Rate....,
         Comments = Comments..e.g...exclusion.)

```


# Save File

```{r}

#Save RDS file to be used for analysis
saveRDS(All_data, here::here("Subjective Data", "All_data_1-Cleaned_Data.rds"))

```
